apiMappings.mapping: @PostMapping("/game/telemetry") public Map<String,Object> receive(@RequestBody BridgeService.Batch batch){return service.receive(batch);}
@GetMapping("/bridge/admin") public BridgeService.Admin admin(@RequestParam long telegramUserId){return service.admin(telegramUserId);}
@GetMapping public List<BroadcastService.Post> list(@RequestParam long telegramUserId){return service.list(telegramUserId);}
@PostMapping public BroadcastService.Post create(@RequestBody BroadcastService.Draft body){return service.create(body);}
@GetMapping("/{id}") public BroadcastService.Post get(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestParam long telegramUserId){return service.get(telegramUserId,id);}
@PostMapping("/{id}/publish") public BroadcastService.Post publish(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestBody Admin body){return service.publish(body.telegramUserId(),id);}
@PostMapping("/{id}/cancel") public BroadcastService.Post cancel(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestBody Admin body){return service.cancel(body.telegramUserId(),id);}
@PostMapping("/claim") public List<BroadcastService.Delivery> claim(@RequestBody Admin body){return service.claim(body.telegramUserId());}
@PostMapping("/{id}/ack") public ResponseEntity<Void> ack(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestBody BroadcastService.Ack body){service.acknowledge(id,body);return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();}
@PostMapping("/game/reports") public ReportService.Report submit(@RequestBody ReportService.Submission body){return service.submit(body);}
@GetMapping("/reports") public List<ReportService.Report> open(@RequestParam long telegramUserId,@RequestParam(defaultValue="0")int offset){return service.open(telegramUserId,offset);}
@GetMapping("/reports/summary") public ReportService.Summary summary(@RequestParam long telegramUserId){return service.summary(telegramUserId);}
@GetMapping("/reports/{id}") public ReportService.Report get(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestParam long telegramUserId){return service.get(telegramUserId,id);}
@GetMapping("/reports/{id}/player") public ReportService.PlayerCard player(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestParam long telegramUserId){return service.player(telegramUserId,id);}
@PostMapping("/reports/{id}/actions") public ReportService.Report action(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestBody ReportService.Action body){return service.action(id,body);}
@PostMapping("/reports/notifications/claim") public List<ReportService.Delivery> claim(@RequestBody Admin body){return service.claim(body.telegramUserId());}

@PostMapping("/reports/notifications/{id}/ack") public ResponseEntity<Void> ack(@PathVariable UUID id,@RequestBody Ack body){service.acknowledge(body.telegramUserId(),id,body.leaseToken());return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();}
